Definition: to be right-handed or take the right-hand side
BiblicalUsage: Yâman means to take the right-hand side, to turn right rather than left. The men of Benjamin could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones, and the wise woman told David that none can turn to the right hand or to the left from what the king has spoken.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the right hand is the place of skill and honour, and God marks the difference between right and left.
